verdict.rationale: Foreloop supports creating separate API keys per integration so revoking one doesn't affect others (foreloop-docs-38, foreloop-docs-27), and explicitly offers a 'WRITE_ONLY_KEY' type for feedback-widget use (foreloop-docs-6), showing some scoped credential concept for agent/tool access via MCP (foreloop-docs-5/19). However there is no documentation of granular permission scopes (e.g., read-only, resource-level, or role-based) beyond the single write-only example, so true least-privilege configurability for agents is only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit scope/permission model documentation, evidence of read-only or task-limited keys, and independent confirmation of scope enforcement.
